''See also: [[Telariel Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Telariel, also known as [[Spider of the Abidan|the Spider]], is a prominent member of the [[Abidan Court]] and serves as one of its seven [[Judges]]. Recognized as the busiest of the [[Judges]], Telariel is responsible for coordinating communications across the entire [[Abidan]] organization and scouting for potential invasions. [[Spider of the Abidan|The Spider]] maintains order by spinning invisible webs throughout the universe, a power used to monitor various sectors and intervene in cosmic threats. For example, Telariel has demonstrated the ability to sabotage enemy fleets by misaligning their engines simultaneously. While highly active in managing communications and detecting chaos, Telariel is described as a cultured and prim individual who prefers to manage affairs from a spire rather than risking personal safety in direct combat. The role of [[Spider of the Abidan|the Spider]] was eventually succeeded by [[Ozmanthus Arelius|Ozmanthus]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|[[Ozmanthus Arelius|Ozmanthus]] served as the successor to Telariel within the [[Third Division]].}}
